random answers.rule: Track outstanding insults: start at 0. Insult adds 1. Apologise subtracts 1 if the count is positive, otherwise it stays 0. Gift does nothing. Mood is warm if the final count is 0, cold if it is positive.

rivals choose.rule: Robin starts warm. Insult makes Robin cold and increases the consecutive-insult counter. Apology makes Robin warm if the counter is at most 1; if it is 2 or more, the apology fails and Robin stays cold, then the counter resets to 0. Gift does not change mood but resets the consecutive-insult counter to 0.

rivals.comment: Robin has a hidden trust score: insult subtracts 2, apology/gift add 1, warm when score is positive.
Robin counts insults and kindnesses one-for-one; warm only when kindnesses strictly exceed insults.
Robin stays warm unless an insult is first or two insults happen in a row; these make him cold.
Robin is warm only if the latest non-gift action is an apology and no two insults are adjacent.
Additive score: insult -1, apology +1, gift +0.6; warm iff score > 0.5.
Two reservoirs: insults build anger; apology lowers anger or builds affection if calm; gift builds affection only if calm; warm iff calm and affectionate.
One grudge per unapologised insult; apology cancels one grudge if any; gift is ignored; warm iff no grudge.
Score: insult -1, apology +1, gift +1 only immediately after an apology; warm iff score > 0.
